body: want [MINO++](https://modrinth.com/mod/minopp) mod to use custom UNO cards and/or custom colors and use UNO insted of MINO text and sounds then this is your texture pack/Resource Packs. right now i only have two verions "red, yellow, green, blue, gold for the wiled" and "light Blue, Orange, Light Green, pink, gold for the wiled" but there both cool.
